description: A man has collapsed suddenly at a park. Bystanders report he was clutching his chest before going down. No pulse detected. Time is critical.

examination_findings.head: ⚠ Cyanotic lips and face. Pupils bilaterally dilated 6mm, fixed — consistent with cardiac arrest. No head trauma from fall. GCS 3 (E1V1M1). No response to any stimulus.
examination_findings.neck: No carotid pulse palpable. No JVD. Trachea midline. No neck trauma. Airway obstructed — head tilt chin lift required.
examination_findings.chest: ⚠ No spontaneous breathing. No chest rise. No breath sounds. AED analysis: Ventricular Fibrillation — shockable rhythm. CPR site: lower half of sternum. Begin 30:2 compressions immediately.
examination_findings.abdomen: Soft. No distension. No visible trauma. Not relevant to acute management — focus on CPR/defibrillation.
examination_findings.back: No visible injuries. Minor abrasion from collapse onto path. Not priority — do not delay CPR.
examination_findings.extremities: ⚠ Cool, cyanotic, mottled peripherally. No distal pulses palpable. CRT >5 sec. Pill bottle in pocket: Atorvastatin 40mg — cardiovascular history. No medical alert bracelet.

symptoms.what_happened: (Patient is unresponsive — bystander reports: He grabbed his chest and fell down suddenly.)
symptoms.when_started: (Bystander: It just happened, maybe 2 minutes ago.)

allergies.medication_allergies: (Unknown — no one present knows the patient.)

medications.current_meds: (A small pill bottle found in his pocket — label reads 'Atorvastatin 40mg'.)
medications.what_meds: (Atorvastatin 40mg — a cholesterol medication. No other medications visible.)

past_history.medical_conditions: (Unknown — bystander has no information. Cholesterol medication suggests cardiovascular history.)

events.what_doing: (Bystander: He was walking in the park, then he stopped, grabbed his chest, and collapsed.)
events.witnesses: (Bystander: I was sitting on a bench nearby. I saw the whole thing. A few other people are around too.)
